rows.description: :fire: Powerful, yet easy to use, open-source online ordering, table reservation and management system for restaurants

Enatega is a fully customizable and scalable delivery management system that supports multiple business models and service verticals. It allows you to launch and manage your own ordering and logistics platform for food, groceries, home services, courier delivery, and much more, visit the Enatega product page: 🚀🛒📦🌐
The food ordering & delivery application designed based on the real-life scenario. Anyone can use this code on their own purpose. If you are interested please make your contribution to the code.
